description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential opportunity offers a chance to make a significant impact on resident care and facility success. The ideal candidate will be a visionary leader with a passion for delivering exceptional healthcare services.

In this pivotal role, you will oversee all aspects of facility management, ensuring compliance with state and federal regulations while fostering a positive and supportive environment for both residents and staff. You will be responsible for strategic planning, financial management, and maintaining high standards of quality care.

This position offers a competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, commensurate with experience. Join a team committed to excellence and contribute to a facility renowned for its compassionate care and rehabilitative services.
requirements: Active and unrestricted LNHA license in Maryland
Proven experience as a Nursing Home Administrator in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations (e.g., CMS, DOH)
Strong financial acumen and operational management skills
Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal abilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Frostburg, MD. This leadership role offers a significant opportunity to contribute to patient care excellence and support our nursing team in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in maintaining high standards of care and operational efficiency.

As an ADON, you will assist the Director of Nursing in overseeing daily nursing operations, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards, and fostering a positive work environment. This position is perfect for a compassionate leader who is passionate about making a difference in the lives of residents. We offer a competitive annual salary range of $75,000 - $90,000, commensurate with experience, for this vital full-time position.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license, preferably in Maryland
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, with some leadership or supervisory experience
Experience in a skilled nursing facility or rehabilitation center setting
Strong understanding of nursing best practices and regulatory compliance
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $75,000 - $90,000, commensurate with experience.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) to join a compassionate team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Red Bay, AL. This is an immediate opportunity for a professional who is passionate about providing high-quality patient care in a supportive environment.
In this vital role, you will be responsible for administering medications, performing treatments, and overseeing the care provided by other nursing staff. You will play a crucial part in assessing patient conditions, developing care plans, and ensuring accurate documentation, all while maintaining a focus on patient well-being and safety.
This position requires commitment to 12-hour shifts, offering a consistent schedule to those ready to make an immediate impact. Join a facility dedicated to excellence in patient care and become a valued member of a team that prioritizes both resident health and staff support.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Alabama
Minimum of one year of experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Ability to work 12-hour shifts, including evenings and weekends as needed
Strong clinical assessment, critical thinking, and communication skills

description:
We are seeking dedicated and compassionate Licensed Practical Nurses (LPNs) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Magee, MS. This full-time, permanent position offers an excellent opportunity to provide high-quality patient care in a supportive environment.

This role involves working desirable PM shifts, specifically from 7:00 PM to 7:00 AM, on a consistent 3/2 split schedule. We are looking for professionals who are committed to making a difference in the lives of residents and contributing to a positive team atmosphere.
requirements: Current and valid Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) license in the state of Mississippi
Ability to work full-time PM shifts (7:00 PM - 7:00 AM) on a 3/2 split schedule
Prior experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care facility is preferred
Strong clinical assessment, documentation, and communication skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $25.00 - $28.00, based on experience.
